New Jersey’s #1 source for local news and the definitive voice of the Garden State. 

We don’t just report what is happening. We capture the moments, personalities, and quirks that make New Jersey... New Jersey. 

Whether you grew up here, just moved in, or are checking us out from afar, this channel is your digital town square for all things NJ from breaking headlines to fun, weird, and unforgettable stories. 

Here’s what you’ll get when you subscribe: 

📰 Local News & Smart Deep-Dives 
🍕 Food, Culture & Jersey Lifestyle 
🤔 Fun, Weird & Very NJ Stories 
⚖️ True Crime & Inside the Courts 

New Jersey is more than a place on a map. It’s a vibe, a culture, and a conversation. 

Jump in. Comment, share, and take part in telling the story of the Garden State. 

Subscribe and hit the notification bell so you never miss what’s happening in NJ. 

Get the full story anytime at nj.com 
Follow us everywhere @njdotcom
